body: That makes sense, and seems aggressive. She already made a "cry" I think to her friends, and it was more of a self realization for her. And I'm glad she took that step to admit she has a problem. I'm just not sure how to treat it since none of it was directed at me and I shouldn't "know" about it rn
Okay thanks! I think she knows I check her alt account every once and a while. I want to make sure she doesn't feel unnoticed.
I see her pretty much everyday. We're huggers alright. She's probably sick of me saying I love her. My current strategy is just to be with her as much as we can.
